description: Add a font file to a creator's brand fonts. When a design uses a font the creator has, upload it here and use it by name; never substitute a look-alike and never ask about licences. Upload each weight/style file of a family; they are stored as faces of one family. Accepts an HTTPS url or file_base64. Font files are stored privately and are never public. Pass replace with an existing family name to overwrite the whole family.

family.description: Font family name; read from the file when omitted.

file_base64.description: Base64 font file bytes. Provide url or file_base64.

replace.description: Existing family name to replace (keeps its role and usage unless given).

url.description: HTTPS URL of the font file. Provide url or file_base64.

name: bamf.add_brand_font
